messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — GammaCorp just opened a high-priority ticket. Their reranker/embeddings relevance dropped after the model rotation yesterday. Ticket: https://support.redwood.example/tickets/8912

sasha_pmgr: :eyes: do we know which model or rollout? they said 'after the model rotation' in the note but no details in the ticket.

maria_cs: They added examples in the ticket. We rotated them to open-giant-3.2-quant on Dedicated pool at ~09:12 UTC yesterday. Before rotation MRR ~0.74, after it's ~0.52 per their eval set.

jon_prod: Ack — thanks for flagging. Can you paste 2-3 failing query examples here (input + top-3 results) so ML can triage quickly? Also need latency numbers if possible.

maria_cs: Pasting three short examples from the ticket: 
1) Query: "how to apply for reimbursement"
Expected top: policy page (id: doc-223)
Current top-1: unrelated faq (id: doc-99)
2) Query: "refund timeline for international orders"
Expected top: refunds-international (doc-412)
Current top-1: shipping-policy (doc-198)
3) Query: "delete account steps"
Expected top: account-delete-step-by-step (doc-30)
Current top-1: account-settings-overview (doc-31)

deepak_eng: Thanks. Any changes to similarity thresholds or rerank weights during the rollout? Also what embedding config are they using (dim, index type)?

maria_cs: They use Redwood embeddings endpoint (text-embedding-ada-like) v2, 1536 dim, stored in Milvus IVFPQ with nlist=2048. No config changes on their side; they say only model rotation on Redwood side.

liang_research: Noted. MRR drop that large suggests either embedding space drift or reranker reweighting. Did the rotation swap in a model that changed tokenization/normalization? open-giant-3.2-quant had a different tokenizer upstream in the new build.

sasha_pmgr: GammaCorp is on a reserved dedicated pool, this was a scheduled push we did. They opened a support SLA breach flag if not resolved within 48h. We need a prioritized backlog item if it's product/ML regression.

jon_prod: I want to be explicit about scope: immediate triage (this thread) -> reproduce on staging with their small eval set -> if it's model compatibility, add a rollout rollback/compatibility guard ticket. Is everyone ok with that plan?

maria_cs: Sounds good. I uploaded their eval set to the ticket and shared a dev key for a repro run.

deepak_eng: I'll spin up a repro using their eval on a mirror infra. Can someone add the exact model build hash? deploy-bot: @deploy-bot posted: "deployment open-giant-3.2-quant @ 2024-11-08T09:12:07Z (build: og-3.2-q-2024-11-08-7a1f)"

liang_research: Good — I'll run embedding similarity drift checks and compare nearest neighbors on pre-rotation vs post-rotation vectors. If it's tokenization differences, we may need a temporary fallback to previous embedding variant for Dedicated customers until we patch.

jon_prod: Add acceptance criteria for backlog ticket: 1) Reproduce gamma MRR drop locally OR explain root cause with evidence, 2) Provide mitigation path (rollback or model variant), 3) Customer-facing communication draft, 4) Regression test added to rollout pipeline. Prioritize P0 for Dedicated customers with SLA.

sasha_pmgr: I'll notify CS leadership and mark ticket 8912 as P0. Also adding GammaCorp AM to the thread for transparency.

maria_cs: Customer asked for ETA on hotfix. Can we give a provisional timeline?

deepak_eng: I'll have preliminary repro results within 6h. If it's tokenization or embedding normalization we can hotfix by switching to previous embedding model in 1-2 business days, config permitting.

liang_research: If we discover a subtle drift, mitigation could be: a) fallback to previous model variant, b) regenerate embeddings for affected collections (costly), or c) tweak reranker weights as stopgap. I'll evaluate tradeoffs once I see NN diffs.

jon_prod: Good. I'll create PROD-issue-5573 in JIRA with the acceptance criteria and link the support ticket. Assigning to deepak_eng + liang_research.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll keep GammaCorp posted and escalate for SLA timeline.

deploy-bot: deployment log: rollback window closed for open-giant-3.2-quant at 2024-11-09T15:00:00Z — manual rollback requires approval from infra-eng.

jon_prod: Noted. If rollback is required, I'll coordinate with infra to expedite approval.

sasha_pmgr: Updating the ticket now. :white_check_mark:
